claims.text: Reviewers frequently report visible improvements in skin appearance, including reduced wrinkles, crows feet, and brown spots.
Many reviewers praise the texture, noting it goes on smoothly, absorbs quickly, and is not greasy or oily.
Reviewers commonly describe a light, pleasant scent that is not overpowering.
Several reviewers say they would recommend or repurchase the product, citing its effectiveness and value.
A few reviewers question the authenticity of the positive reviews, with one calling the product a scam.
